Container.Name: Voids
Container.Overview: Voids finds the gaps (voids) in your movie collections: you own a movie but are missing its sequels or other entries in the same collection. It scans Jellyfin and cross-references TMDB to discover missing siblings, then surfaces them for review, RSS (for Radarr), and automation. Background-first with a web UI for configuration and review. Single container, single port (8484). Plex support is planned. Spiritual successor to Gaps by Jason H House.
Container.Description: Voids finds the missing entries in your movie collections by scanning Jellyfin and querying TMDB. App configuration (TMDB key, Jellyfin server, Radarr, notifications, schedule) is done in the web UI and stored on the /data volume. The /rss feeds can be added to Radarr as a list.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP(S) port for the web UI, API, WebSocket, and RSS feeds.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data directory: SQLite database and any generated TLS certs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as and owns /data. unRAID default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as and owns /data. unRAID default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: Sub-path mount point when served behind a reverse proxy (default /).

Config.Name: AUTH_MODE
Config.Description: Auth mode: none (open, trusted LAN) or basic (HTTP Basic). /rss stays public.

Config.Name: AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Basic-auth password (only used when AUTH_MODE=basic). Hashed on boot, never logged.

Config.Name: TLS
Config.Description: off (plain HTTP, terminate TLS at a proxy) or on (self-signed cert into /data/tls).

Config.Name: TMDB_RATE_LIMIT
Config.Description: TMDB token-bucket sustained rate, in requests/second.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log level: error | warn | log | debug | verbose. Secrets are always redacted.
